newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Trust Fund operational Q1 1997-SET.
newsitem.headline: Thai Trust Fund operational Q1 1997-SET.

text.p: The Thai Trust Fund, an open-ended mutual fund allowing foreign investors to circumvent ownership restrictions on Thai stock purchases, will be operational in the first quarter of 1997, the stock exchange said on Tuesday.
Sopawadee Lertmanaschai, head of the SET's examinations department, said it would take at least 90 days to establish the fund following cabinet approval of the scheme last week.
She said about 30 Thai listed companies were currently interested in making their shares available to international investors through the fund.
